purpose: Test whether fast-decay v6 can consolidate complementary task modes beyond the raw macro400 observed-best before measuring per-task gradient conflict.

derivation.deployment: one inference-only Writer state, one load, one Writer forward per video

candidates.name: uniform_m350_m400
candidates.rationale: local endpoint smoothing after parameter motion has become tiny

candidates.name: uniform_m200_m350_m400
candidates.rationale: combine the strongest language-10, goal, object, and spatial allocation modes

candidates.name: uniform_m200_m250_m350_m400
candidates.rationale: broaden across all noncollapsed second-segment modes while excluding macro300

candidates.name: uniform_m150_m200_m250_m300_m350_m400
candidates.rationale: matched broad late-six SWA candidate for direct comparison with the original-v6 averaging result

evaluation.panel: fixed development validation 8 tasks x 50 official init states
evaluation.pairing: identical state, environment seed, policy seed/noise prefix, and teacher-video assignment across candidates and the raw curve

decision_rule.primary: correct400 absolute performance and multi-task breadth relative to raw macro400=143
decision_rule.hard_target: prefer at least 150/400 while retaining a margin of at least 30 over corrected Source-SFT=109
decision_rule.paired_evidence: report gained/lost paired episodes and exact two-sided sign test
decision_rule.specificity: a winning average must undergo the existing five-arm and internal transmission checks before becoming an AS observed-best
decision_rule.failure_next_step: if no candidate improves the raw best credibly, quantify per-task gradient conflict before changing update granularity or Procedure-to-compiler
